description: Studio Domain Allowing Notebook Output Sharing
rationale: With sharing allowed, a Studio user can publish a notebook - including the output of every cell that has been run - to an S3 location and get back a URL that reproduces it for anybody who opens it. The cell output is the point: it is the query results, the sample rows, the aggregates and whatever else the notebook printed while working on the account's data, and it leaves in a form that no bucket policy review would ever have looked at, because the bucket is SageMaker's sharing location rather than a data store. The setting is a domain-level default, so it applies to every user profile that does not override it.
remediation: Set the notebook output option of the domain default user settings to Disabled, or, where sharing is genuinely needed, keep it on with a sharing S3 location and a KMS key the account controls and review who can read them
